harness.reasoning_note: opencode --variant=high on @ai-sdk/google sends generationConfig.thinkingConfig={includeThoughts:true, thinkingLevel:'high'}, maxOutputTokens=32000 (verified 2026-09-26 against a logging proxy for all three rung models; no variant also yields thinkingLevel 'high'). The benchmark wrapper's default reasoning_effort is 'high'; kept for every rung (gemini-3.8-flash cannot run with thinking off). opencode also makes one title-generation call per session (thinkingLevel 'low', temperature 0.5) that is not in step_finish accounting.

user_sim.reasoning: provider default (harness sets no reasoning_effort / thinking config)
user_sim.max_concurrent_calls_note: quota ~4 concurrent short calls; patient retry in the local patch

judge.reason: OpenAI key has no credit (results/redo_v1/OPENAI_CREDIT_STOP_20260926.json); user decision: Gemini-only seats
judge.replacement: final pass = the task's own tests/test.sh reward (the verifier result already in each trial) together with the frozen per-intent judge on the final snapshot (fsa.redo.metrics; configs/intents/swe-together/JUDGE_FREEZE.json). Gate 1 depends on the per-intent judge only. `run judge` passes --skip-correctness; the tagger and intent-coverage seats still run.

was.client: codex exec in a fresh E2B sandbox of the task image (benchmark's JUDGE_VIA_CODEX path)
was.auth: API-key auth.json (codex login --with-api-key) via SWT_CODEX_AUTH_JSON; never the host ChatGPT OAuth file
was.deviation: official judge is Claude Opus (claude --print); no Anthropic key. Recorded deviation, calibrated in Stage 0 (PLAN.md 5.1, 5.4).

intent_judge.backend: Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint (fsa.redo.llm_seats), strict JSON schema, patient retry
intent_judge.serves: per-intent judge v2 (analysis), in-trial overlay trigger (fsa.redo.intent_judge, read at trial start), applicability, intent-to-check mapper
intent_judge.was: gpt-5.5, effort medium (overlay trigger and v1 judge) until 2026-09-26

S.thinking: thinkingLevel=high (opencode --variant=high); thinking cannot be disabled on this model

e2b.image: official amd64 task image from task.toml (ghcr.io/togetherbench/multi-user-turn-codebench/<task>:<tag>) built into an E2B template tb-<task>__<dirhash8>
e2b.deviation: E2B account is on the hobby tier (sandbox lifetime <= 1 h, 'Timeout cannot be greater than 1 hours'). Official budget is TRIAL_BUDGET_SEC=5400 (90 min) with agent_timeout 4800; on E2B we run TRIAL_BUDGET_SEC=3000, agent_timeout 3300, sandbox 3600. Stage 0 only; Stage 1 trials run on local docker with the official budget.

docker_arm64.note: native arm64 rebuilds from ${SWE_BENCHMARK_ARM_DIR:-../swe_benchmark_arm} (gold-validated per task in swe_together/status.json); the judge still runs on E2B (official image)

docker_amd64.note: x86_64 hosts (x86 replicate, 2026-09-28): the task's official amd64 image from task.toml (ghcr.io/togetherbench/multi-user-turn-codebench/<task>:<tag>), run natively - no rebuild, no template; selected automatically on amd64 hosts (fsa.redo.swe_together.run.sandbox_key). Official budget.

stage1_caps_note: Stage 1 starting concurrency from the Stage 0 token measurements (PLAN.md 5.2): W 8, M 4, S 2 concurrent trials; raise to W 16, M 6-8, S 5-6 only after the first batch shows no 429 (pilot --cap W=16,M=7,S=5, or edit stage1_trial_cap). Global container cap: pilot --max-total (14).
